text:
Oh hey!
I didn't expect any visitors.
zh:
哦，嘿！
我可没想到会有客人来。

text: Do you need something?
zh: 你有什么事吗？

text: Who are you?
zh: 你是谁？

text: Who is imprisoned in the dungeon?
zh: 地牢里关的都是些什么人？

text: Am I allowed to look inside the cells?
zh: 我可以看看牢房里面吗？

text: I know you! You were in the cave near the waterfall.
zh: 我认得你！你之前在瀑布附近的洞穴里。

text: I need to go.
zh: 我得走了。

text: I am #:Cornelia:#, the overseer of the castle dungeon.
zh: 我是#:科妮莉亚:#，城堡地牢的看守长。

text: It's not exactly inviting down here, but at least I have some peace and quiet.
zh: 下面这地方算不上宜人，但至少我落得清静。

text: Were there any escape attempts?
zh: 有人试图越狱过吗？

text: That's all I wanted to know.
zh: 我想知道的就这些。

text: All kinds of rabble and criminals.
zh: 各种地痞流氓和罪犯。

text: Some are imprisoned here for theft, and there are also a few murderers among the prisoners.
zh: 有些人是因为偷窃被关进来的，囚犯里还有几个杀人犯。

text: Here and there, prisoners simply disappear.
zh: 时不时地，就会有囚犯凭空消失。

text: However, we do not yet know how they can escape from their cells.
zh: 不过，我们还不清楚他们是怎么从牢房里逃出去的。

text: You need something else?
zh: 你还有别的事吗？

text: As far as I'm concerned, you can look at the empty cells.
zh: 要我说，空牢房你随便看。

text: But don't even think about hiding anything in the cells or taking anything with you!
zh: 但你可别想在牢房里藏东西，或者顺手带走什么！

text: Finally some peace again.
zh: 总算又清静了。

text:
Oh shit!
I didn't expect you to recognize me...
zh:
哦，糟了！
没想到你居然认出我了……

text:
Listen. All this stealing is just a little side hustle.
Really nothing worth talking about.
zh:
听着，偷东西只是我的一点小副业。
真的不值一提。

text: Why don't we forget about it?
zh: 咱们就当没这回事，怎么样？

text: Why should I forget about it?
zh: 我凭什么当没这回事？

text: No, I will report this.
zh: 不行，我要上报这件事。

text: I'm sure I have something that will interest you.
zh: 我肯定有能让你感兴趣的东西。

text: You'll have to catch me first, sweetie!
zh: 那你得先抓得住我，小可爱！

text: If you don't rat me out, you can have the #:key to the chest behind the waterfall:# from me.
zh: 只要你不告发我，我就把#:瀑布后面宝箱的钥匙:#给你。

text: You might also be interested in a little #:secret about this dungeon:# here.
zh: 你可能还会对一个#:关于这座地牢的小秘密:#感兴趣。

text: The chest is already open. I don't need the key.
zh: 那箱子已经开了。我不需要钥匙。

text: Ok, we have a deal.
zh: 行，成交。

text: No, I will report this.
zh: 不行，我要上报这件事。

text:
What?!
How did you open the chest?
zh:
什么？！
你是怎么打开那箱子的？

text:
Oh, it doesn't matter.
Then you'll just get some gold from me.
zh:
哦，算了，无所谓。
那我就给你一些金币好了。

text: Hehe, I knew it!
zh: 嘿嘿，我就知道！

text: Here, take these 1000 gold coins.
zh: 给，拿上这1000金币。

text: This is the key to the chest.
zh: 这是那个宝箱的钥匙。

text: And now listen to me carefully.
zh: 现在，仔细听我说。

text:
The recent escapes here were no accident.
There are some good thieves down here who are better off outside.
zh:
最近这里的几起越狱可不是偶然。
这下面关着几个手艺不错的小偷，与其蹲牢里，不如放出去。

text: There's a special cell in the western cellblock for prisoners who want to join my gang.
zh: 西边牢区有一间特殊的牢房，专门留给想加入我团伙的囚犯。

text:
A secret #:switch on a candlestick:# briefly opens a #:wall in the cell:#.
There, a path leads into the crypt, from which you can get outside.
zh:
一个隐秘的#:烛台上的开关:#能让#:牢房里的一面墙:#短暂开启。
那里有条路通向墓穴，从墓穴就能到外面去。

text:
But don't venture too far into the crypt.
Something's not right down there.
zh:
但别在墓穴里走得太深。
下面有些不对劲。
